scope: Static USB HS pad states under full-rate host switching, 242 mA single-active-wired-branch budget, 500 pF and current package target. Internal timing/core pulse means replace portions of their existing 40 mA owners. 156.25 MHz internal pulses are assigned stress loads, not a USB clock implementation. Two signal bonds, local/remote terminations and pad-return feedback included. No REF_IN current, signal-dependent driver loading, real edges, squelch/chirp, packet lifecycle or protocol qualification. 20 mV quiet-pin value is the existing instantaneous design guard; observer-bandwidth controls are diagnostic, not a compliance instrument.
